claim: Getting an SSD really worth it? : r/PS4Pro - Reddit
summary: I use it for ps4 games, they are not optimized to use the ps5 M.2 drive anyway so they don't take up ps5 space if they are on external drive, but they still load much faster with ssd than with regular external hdd, and it's cheaper than expanding the storage of ps5 with a proper m2 drive.
